mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 59 degrees.
October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz issued a proclamation honoring our planning department for their data-driven work and commitment to our community's future.

Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the World Dairy Expo or the apple cider festival at the Farley Center.
On September 21, local officers investigated a retail theft where a subject was identified on surveillance footage for stealing Swedish Fish candy.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's. The Verona Culver's is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
